data.one_liner: An ImageProvider that uses the http package instead of dart:io.
data.what_it_does: Provides an image provider that makes network image requests using the package:http client instead of the default dart:io implementation. Allows custom clients such as cupertino_http, cronet_http, or tracing via Sentry.
use_when: You need to use cupertino_http or cronet_http for fetching images
You need to trace HTTP image requests with tools like Sentry
avoid_when: You do not need custom HTTP clients and standard Image.network is sufficient
strengths: Allows dynamic configuration of HTTP implementations via package:http
Supports custom clients globally or per instance
